_frame: metres; origin = centre of the ground footprint (y = 0 at the base); front toward +Z; x across the track. size {w,h,d} at scale 1. Load with MeshoptDecoder (core assets.js does).

gate-checkpoint.note: checkpoint arch; cyan LED strip under the span and on the inner legs (emissive). Inner clear width given at scale 1: scale so it clears the track.

gantry-sign.note: toll-road sign gantry, signs read Semanggi / Senayan on the +Z face; the back of the signs is plain grey steel.

bridge-jpo.note: covered pedestrian bridge, span centred on x = 0, stairs at both ends; warm lit interior (emissive). Clear height under the deck given at scale 1.

monument.note: Bundaran centre monument, 45 m; warm uplights at the base (emissive). Anchor = plinth base centre.

tower-glass.note: office tower, ~30 floors drawn at ~4.5 m: 149 m at scale 1; lit floors + cyan crown line (emissive).

tower-res.note: apartment slab, ~22 floors: 86 m at scale 1, roof tank and antennas; some lit windows (emissive).

kampung-block.note: cluster of 8 two-storey kampung houses, seen mostly from above; a few lit windows (emissive). Rotate in 90/180 deg steps for variety.
